name: feature-folders
description: Architecture-agnostic structure guardrails: global buckets (components, hooks, providers, lib, config, api) plus feature/page/layout modules, a scaffolder, and hooks that reject a new file outside them, a wrong filename, or model content (a type, a constant, a schema, a hook, an HTTP call) in the wrong place — placement and naming only ever block a new file, so a legacy project stays untouched.
